apps.releaseNotes:
A seventh theme, a quieter top bar, and a player that stops promising an action it is already doing.

- New: CARETAKER, a seventh theme - deep ocean blue with a single warm accent. Themes are under Settings, Appearance.
- Changed: the clock and the Multi-View button in the top bar were filled, glowing accent pills. They are now quiet outlined controls, so the picture is what stands out.
- Fixed: while a channel was loading, the play button showed a play triangle and promised an action that was already under way. It now shows Pause, which is what pressing it actually does, and a single ring in the middle shows that it is still loading.
- Fixed: with the guide's live preview turned off, opening a channel still took two presses, and the first one showed you nothing. One press now opens it.
- New: channel results in search show what is on right now, not just the category.
- Fixed: four places used their own fixed colours instead of your theme - the LIVE badge, the Pro screen, and two in Multi-View. The LIVE badge could be red while the guide showed LIVE in your theme's colour, two colours for the same thing on one screen. And on OLED Black, which exists to be completely black, the Pro screen was a grey box.
- Faster: the hide-categories list recounted the entire catalogue on every keystroke in its search field. On a large library, typing there no longer stutters.
- Updated: the video engine is new. This is the same update that fixes audio sync on Apple TV; on iPhone and iPad nothing was wrong, but both now run the same engine.

apps.releaseNotes:
This update significantly improves playback resume, speeds up app startup, and brings numerous interface improvements, especially on Mac.

PLAYBACK RESUME

• Your playback position is now saved whenever you leave a movie or episode, including when closing the app or navigating back.
• Automatic saving every 30 seconds: an unexpected app closure will no longer cause you to lose your progress.
• Your position is saved before moving on to the next episode.
• Resuming a movie now starts almost instantly: the stream opens directly at the correct position instead of loading from the beginning.
• For movies available in multiple versions (standard, 4K), playback resumes from the position you actually reached, regardless of which version you launch.
• The next episode prompt now disappears if you go back.

LIBRARY

• Fixed an issue that could cause entire categories to disappear from M3U playlists.
• The language filter can no longer hide almost an entire catalog when titles do not include language tags.
• Library loading is significantly faster: filtering a catalog of 76,000 movies is now three times faster than before.
• Favorite channels removed from the catalog by your provider remain visible and can now be properly removed from your favorites.

ACCOUNT AND SYNC

• Fixed an issue that could permanently switch the app to local storage, disabling cloud sync without any indication on screen.
• Fixed a gray screen in Settings when the session had expired.
• Your Pro status is no longer temporarily lost in the event of a network error.
• Your favorites and history remain linked to your source, even after signing in again.
• Added a new “Sign In” option in Settings.

INTERFACE

• Mac: Back buttons no longer appear underneath the window controls.
• Mac: the Settings page now makes better use of available space on larger screens.
• Player: titles are no longer unnecessarily truncated, and on narrow windows secondary controls are grouped into a menu instead of disappearing.
• Player: the play/pause button now adapts to the size of the window.
• The Enter key can now be used to submit sign-in details and all other forms.

PRIVACY

• Your provider credentials can no longer appear in error messages or debug reports.

PERFORMANCE AND STABILITY

• Significantly faster app startup.
• The app can no longer remain stuck during startup if synchronization does not respond.
• Debug reports now include more information, helping us investigate and resolve your reports faster.
